title: Men in Black interrogation about the control panel at DIA
summary: Lyn Buchanan tells of Men in Black interrogation about the control panel at DIA, about late 1980s at Defense Intelligence Agency, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: it. And the guy over to the side slapped his leg and said, "So that's it."

plain: Lyn Buchanan, a former Army sergeant, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about the late 1980s at the Defense Intelligence Agency, a US military intelligence agency, where he worked with a colleague named Ed Dames. He says mysterious men, the kind people call Men in Black, questioned him about a craft's control panel he had described, and when he explained it, one man off to the side slapped his leg and said, 'So that's it.' If true, it would mean someone already had such a craft and was using his answers to understand it.
